posts.content_md: Dave very nice. The video comes in great. The hologram has nice depth. Did you fabricate the DCG emulsion yourself? Processing looks nice and clean.

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
thanks john, yes i did coat ,your method and dannys (using draw bar w/tape side rails).Im still not using the laminar flow.... stand by

the tip from the ru holography forum, about using the cotton swab to remove the dust bumps(during the last bath),really helped to clean things up!

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md: Funny you stated that. The last batch of plates I made I used the finest draw bar I have with Scotch tape around the sides of the glass and was very pleased with the results. Also, I found that when you make your emulsion, and then filter it, you may see a couple of bubbles. You can also take a cotton swab, or I use the corner of a paper towel, to lift these bubbles out of the emulsion prior to coating. I found these to be a detrimental if they ended up on the plate. Keep up the good work and congratulation on your work. It looks great.
